latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: master hub skill for structured web application penetration testing.

- Orchestrates a complete, sequenced penetration test across 13 web application security areas.
- Delegates each testing area to specialized domain skills and coordinates workflow between them.
- Serves as a comprehensive checklist to ensure all critical security testing phases are covered.
- Guides planning, execution, and reporting for authorized, full-scope web application assessments.
- Designed for experienced security professionals conducting assessments with explicit authorization.
